about.title: About R.L.NELSON – Foundation Repair & Root Barrier Houston
text: The Nelson name has been part of the Southeast Texas foundation-repair industry since 1978.
Learn how Dick and Ann Nelson established the foundation-repair business in Baytown and how the Nelson name has continued through decades of foundation and structural work.

With over 47 years of experience, R L NELSON Foundation Solutions (Formerly known as R L Nelson Construction and Foundation Repair), established in 1978, is a trusted leader in foundation repair and structural services across Southeast Texas. We proudly serve both residential and commercial properties, including churches, schools, and government facilities. Our clients include respected institutions like the Department of Interior, Texas A&M University, and Rice University, as well as municipalities throughout the region.
